source: Pew Research Center. 2012. "2011 National Survey of Mormons."
method: Population is all respondents (self-identified Mormons by the survey's own design), broken out by self-reported activity level in the Church (q406). q409c asks whether the respondent believes the president of the LDS/Mormon Church is a prophet of God; its own don't know/refused is excluded from each row's denominator. Weighted by the dataset's own `weight` variable.
